observations: Multiple tall cylindrical vessels stored in a warehouse.

The unwrapped vessel has red-handled manual valves and flange connections (photo 0).

The exposed tank in photo 0 shows a polished stainless steel finish.
The design in photo 0 is typical of industrial pressure filter vessels used in water treatment.
Wooden crates are visible in photos 1 and 2, but their contents, labels, and origin are not shown.
There is no nameplate or scale reference in the photos to confirm the volume of the tanks.

A photo of the nameplate or a material test certificate (MTC).

risks.proof: Photos of the labels on the chemical bags or containers inside the crates.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's nameplate on the tanks showing capacity and material grade.
Photos of the labels on the chemical bags/containers.

response.reason: The seller lists two different capacities and mentions chemicals, but no nameplates or labels are visible to confirm these specifications. The material grade (304 vs 316) is also unknown and significantly impacts the price.
